Our priority authorization is filed on Thorgeld.|Roark Garnet attempts to bluff the Imperial Customs Frigate ''Assessor''|<ref name="TRG1" />}}
'''Thorgeld I''', also known as '''Thorgeld''', was a [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]. The [[Mandel family mansion|mansion]] of [[Fabritech/Legends|Fabritech, Inc.]] head [[Kvarn Mandel]] and [[Mandel family|his family]] was located on the planet, in the underground [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Fabrin (city)|Fabrin]]. During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the crew of the [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] ''[[Dorion Discus]]'' visited Thorgeld I. Shortly after the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] left the planet, the [[Imperial Customs Frigate]] [[Assessor (Imperial Customs Frigate)|''Assessor'']] attempted to board the [[Starship/Legends|vessel]] for a [[Imperial Office of Customs/Legends|customs]] [[Customs Inspector|inspection]], but the ''Dorion Discus'' eventually escaped into [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].

==Description==
Thorgeld I,<ref name="GG9" /> also known simply as Thorgeld, was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TRG1" /> that occupied the first [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position<ref name="GG9" /> in the [[Thorgeld system/Legends|Thorgeld system]], a part of the [[Northern Dependencies/Legends|Northern Dependencies]] portion of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
{{Quote|I.N.S. ''Assessor'', calling stock light freighter. Identify yourself, please.''"<br />"''Ah, ''Assessor'', this is the freighter ''Dorion Discus''.''"<br />"''Stand by, ''Dorion Discus''. Prepare for customs inspection.|Roark Garnet responds to the Imperial Customs Frigate ''Assessor'' hailing the ''Dorion Discus'' over Thorgeld I|<ref name="TRG1" />}}
At some point during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], the crew of the [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] ''[[Dorion Discus]]''&mdash;which included the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Roark Garnet/Legends|Roark Garnet]]; the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Tantos Dree]]; the retired [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] [[Jackson Farseeker]]; and Farseeker's [[Gender/Legends|granddaughter]] and Garnet's daughter, [[Jill Farseeker|Jill]]&mdash;visited Thorgeld I. Shortly after leaving the planet, the ''Dorion Discus'' was confronted by the [[Imperial Customs Frigate]] [[Assessor (Imperial Customs Frigate)|''Assessor'']], which ordered Garnet's [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] to stand by for [[Imperial Office of Customs/Legends|customs]] [[Customs Inspector|inspection]] boarding.<ref name="TRG1" />

Hoping to stall for [[Time/Legends|time]] before executing a [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] jump out of the [[Star system/Legends|system]], Garnet contacted the ''Assessor'' and claimed that the ''Dorion Discus'' could not be boarded. The smuggler further bluffed that his [[Starship/Legends|starship]] was carrying important cargo for the [[Unidentified Imperial base (Markon IV)|Imperial base]] on the celestial body [[Markon IV]] and that priority authorization for the shipment had been filed on Thorgeld I. However, the crew of the ''Assessor'' did not fall for Garnet's attempt at bluff and fired a warning shot at his ship in response. Eventually, the ''Dorion Discus'' engaged the [[Frigate/Legends|frigate]] in [[Space warfare/Legends|combat]] above Thorgeld I before finally escaping to hyperspace.<ref name="TRG1" />

==Locations==
[[Fabrin (city)|Fabrin]] was an underground [[City/Legends|city]] on Thorgeld I that featured a maze of corridors. The [[Mandel family mansion|mansion]] of [[Kvarn Mandel]], the head of [[Fabritech/Legends|Fabritech, Inc.]], and [[Mandel family|his family]] was located in the corridors of Fabrin during the time between the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] and the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. Despite regularly traveling to his company's [[Sector/Legends|sector]] headquarters, Mandel returned home on Thorgeld I at least once a [[Standard month/Legends|month]].<ref name="GG9" />

==Behind the scenes==
The planet Thorgeld was first mentioned in the [[1987]] [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game (first edition)|rulebook]] for the first edition of [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="TRG1" /> ''[[Galaxy Guide 9: Fragments from the Rim]]'', a [[1993]] ''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'' sourcebook written by [[Simon Smith]] and [[Eric S. Trautmann]], provided the planet's full name.<ref name="GG9" /> In [[2009]], the reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Thorgeld system, and therefore Thorgeld I, in grid square L-9.<ref name="TEA" />
